# Native course playback fixture

`mobile-course.mp4` is a self-authored 45-second, 160×90, 12 fps H.264/MP4 color animation with no audio, personal information or third-party footage. It was generated locally with macOS AVFoundation for deterministic browser/Android playback, pause, seeking and resumption acceptance. It is test data only and is not included in the APK bundle. Its use and redistribution follow the repository's license.
